fact: The EACO regional communications statistics report covers Tanzania as one of EACO's seven member states, with its regulator TCRA submitting 2024 and 2025 data to the East African Communications Organisation.
EACO reports Tanzania's One Network Area cross-border voice traffic for 2025 as 148.0 million inbound minutes (+36.4%) and 577.7 million outbound minutes (+59.0%, from 363.3 million).

The EAC Secretariat reports that the 3rd Project Steering Committee of the Eastern Africa Regional Digital Integration Project, held in Nairobi on 5-6 May 2026, brought together members from all eight EAC Partner States, Tanzania among them, who reaffirmed their commitment to regional digital integration.

fact: Tanzania hosted the fifth annual East African Communications Organisation (EACO) postal and logistics meeting in Arusha on 14 October 2026, opened by Deputy Minister Dk Switbert Mkama, per Mwananchi.
The EAC says its Regional E-Commerce Engagement Platform meeting on e-commerce and digital trade was held in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, on 13-15 October 2026.
The EAC says the 7-11 July 2026 technical meeting on the Rwanda-Tanzania payment proof of concept was held in Zanzibar and chaired by Nestory Nicholas Maro of the Bank of Tanzania.
A technical meeting under the EAC Cross-Border Payment System Masterplan, held 10-14 November 2025 in Kigali, was chaired by Fabian Ladislaus Kasole of the Bank of Tanzania, according to the EAC.
